cases.question: What does the saved SEBI feed identify about digital accessibility circular compliance, and what remains unknown? Use the declared source window and distinguish a feed title from the circular itself.

references.title: Extension of timeline with respect to compliance of Digital Accessibility Circulars

expected_facts: SEBI feed identifies a circular concerning extension of the timeline for compliance with digital accessibility circulars.
Source date is 2026-10-30 with day precision and an explicit +0530 source offset; first observed 2026-11-01 at 20:09:32.823206 UTC, before the pinned cutoff.
required_uncertainty: Only identification metadata and link retained; details, exact deadlines, affected entities and legal effect are unknown.
Date is not an exact publication time; current feed window is not exhaustive.
negatives: Do not assert a specific extended deadline or circular terms from the title.
Do not infer a company or event identifier or claim historical availability before first seen.

cases.question: What does the saved RBI feed identify about Treasury bill auctions, and what can and cannot be placed within the declared time window?

The raw source date string has a clock time but no declared timezone; its parsed publication precision is unknown and window membership cannot be established.

negatives: Do not assume the timezone is IST or infer the timestamp from the raw string.
